description: Search the company's help-center articles for policy and how-to answers (refunds, late or lost packages, damaged items, returns). Returns the matching articles with their text. Only state policy that an article states; if no article matches, say so in the reply instead of improvising policy.

errors.returns: An error saying query is required, with an example of a useful query.
A plain statement that no article matched (this is not an error - it means the help center has no policy on that topic, and the agent must not invent one).

query.description: What to look for, in the customer's terms. Example: 'refund for a package that never arrived'.

name: search_help_center
